scope: Durable unfinished design drafts, explicit conflict comparison, installed restart recovery, and normal workspace scanning beneath hidden parent directories. No new model inference.

draftCases.name: durable design drafts restores unfinished text and the original context without writing a project or design
durable design drafts isolates projects and refuses stale writers or silent context replacement
durable design drafts keeps input on failed confirmation and consumes only the reviewed draft revision
durable design drafts detects same-revision manual edits and corrupt records without overwriting them

browser.data: Synthetic structure and browser-local storage mock; real React components
checks: typing persists unfinished draft without confirming a design
external design change blocks stale confirmation
comparison shows original, current and draft values
another change after opening comparison rejects stale rebase
explicit rebase preserves input and separate confirmation consumes draft

limitations: Browser fixture is not installed Webview pointer/keyboard end-to-end automation
Installed recovery uses an explicit deterministic stdio fixture, not external AI
Only acknowledged draft writes are promised across restart; queued unsent edits and power loss are outside this proof
No cross-device draft sync or automatic multi-window merge
